transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get our pre-job huddle going for Friday's annual crane inspection in Bay 2. I need maintenance, production scheduling, and EHS to weigh in on the work plan before I finalize anything. We've got eight finished frames staged in the bay already, and four more coming in during the week, so we need to think through how to manage frame movement while the crane is down for inspection. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something before we go any further. During my inspection this morning, I found the crane brake lining is at 18% remaining. Our maintenance standard requires immediate removal from service below 20%. This isn't just about Friday's scheduled inspection — the crane needs to come down now. Once we do the brake replacement, which is a 6-hour job, we also have to run a 125% rated-capacity proof-load test before it can go back into service. I haven't entered this in the maintenance system yet, but I'm telling you all now so we can plan around it.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share my shipping schedule before we plan around the crane downtime. I received confirmation from the customer logistics desk this morning: exactly 8 frames must be moved to shipping by Thursday at 15:00. The remaining 4 frames can stay in Bay 2 until Monday. I haven't updated the shared production board with this yet, but it's critical for our planning — if the crane comes down now for the brake work, we need to make sure those 8 frames get to shipping before Thursday afternoon.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag an EHS concern before we finalize any plan. During my walkdown, I found that the forklift route through Bay 2 crosses the active pedestrian aisle, so forklifts may not substitute for the overhead crane there. Additionally, any crane work or proof-load test requires a 10-meter exclusion zone and a designated spotter. I recorded this in my walkdown notes but haven't issued the bay notice yet, so you're all hearing it now for the first time.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Remove the Bay 2 crane from service immediately due to brake lining at 18% remaining, below the 20% minimum standard.
Prioritize moving all 8 customer-committed frames to shipping via the crane before it is taken offline for brake replacement. Deadline is Thursday 15:00.

Issue bay notice for 10-meter exclusion zone and designated spotter requirement during all crane work and proof-load testing. No forklift substitution permitted in Bay 2 due to pedestrian aisle crossing.
After 6-hour brake replacement, complete 125% rated-capacity proof-load test before returning crane to service.
Remaining 4 frames to stay staged in Bay 2 until crane is back in service and can be moved on Monday.
